Serpentes Elapidae Acanthophis A. antarcticus

Acanthophis antarcticus is a useful guide through this dataset because its genus is compact enough to see as a group, but varied enough to show how one branch opens outward.

It belongs to Elapidae and sits within Acanthophis beside several other recorded species. The connected cards below keep those relatives tied to the same branch.

In this branch, the featured species is one of 8 records in its genus.
